# LINGXIFIELD / 灵犀场

> LINGXIFIELD is a multilingual productivity platform for SASI creation, AI-agent workspaces, and practical online tools.

Canonical site: https://lingxifield.com
Chinese access domain: https://lingxifield.cn
Languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic

## Current product areas
- SASI creation and building
- AI short drama workflow
- Book and document to queryable SASI / AI agent
- Learning SASI
- Research SASI
- Website and app building
- PDF tools
- Image tools
- Video and subtitle tools
- OCR and recognition tools
- Spreadsheet and file conversion
- Temporary email and burn-after-reading privacy tools

## Important
Legacy consciousness-manifestation, divination, field-testing and spiritual-practice pages are retired and return HTTP 410. They are not current LINGXIFIELD products.
